title: Why sell options: time decay and its risks
summary: How theta pays the seller, why sellers win often, and why one bad move can still sink them.

questions.q: Which part of an OTM option's premium is time value?
questions.why: An OTM option has no intrinsic value, so its whole premium is time value.

options: The option's sensitivity to the stock price

questions.q: A seller wins 9 months out of 10 but the 10th month's loss is 12 months of premium. Overall they:
questions.why: 9 months of gains minus 12 months of gains is a net loss. Win rate alone isn't enough.
